content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, so those paths are unavailable. Resubmission would not cure the authorization defect, while a formal appeal is permitted with the CO-197 denial and is the only available payer action that can still seek coverage. Patient billing is premature because the payer appeal path has not been exhausted.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
